negative_findings.description: Direct HTTP fetch of https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. The portal is indexed by search engines and referenced by numerous live government pages, so this is almost certainly a WAF/bot-defence response rather than a dead endpoint. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The primary source of this cell cannot be collected with a plain HTTP fetcher; the collection pipeline must budget for a headless browser with realistic headers, or use the data.gov.mk bulk publication instead.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language searches combining e-nabavki with payments-specific terms ("POS терминали", "банкарски софтвер", "избор на најповолен понудувач") returned no individual banking/payments award notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines surfaced only the portal shell, unrelated tender PDFs (customs, water utility, EVN) and practitioner manuals. No named vendor award for core banking, card systems, POS or ATM supply was located from outside the portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award-level content on the ESJN is behind a JS grid and is effectively not search-indexed. Vendor evidence for this cell must be obtained by querying the portal itself, not by web search — this changes the collection design fundamentally.

negative_findings.description: No official, documented public API or OpenAPI specification for the ESJN was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only an undocumented ASMX endpoint (Infrastructure.asmx/LoadLanguage) leaked into search results, plus a community scraper documenting a dossier page URL with Id/Level parameters. Bureau/Ministry pages describe modules but not programmatic access.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine access is possible but unofficial and fragile; the pipeline needs a monitored, versioned scraper plus a fallback to data.gov.mk bulk files.

negative_findings.description: The data.gov.mk publication of the ESJN 'concluded contracts' module was described by secondary sources but its actual file URL, schema, field coverage and update cadence were not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal is confirmed to exist and to carry a redirecting link to the download location; the download itself was not opened.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If this dataset is complete and current it removes most scraping cost for A6; if it is stale or omits the awarded-operator field it is nearly useless. This is the single highest-leverage thing to verify next.

negative_findings.description: No mapping was established between the CPV/subject codes used in the ESJN and banking/payments IT categories (core banking, card management, POS/ATM hardware, payment switch, HSM, personalisation).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches did not surface a Macedonian CPV list applied to financial-sector IT procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a CPV/keyword filter set the collector must either fetch everything or risk missing awards; building this mapping is a prerequisite for efficient, recall-safe collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The primary portal is bot-defended and its award data is not search-indexed, so no reliable read path has been proven yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a headless-browser probe against e-nabavki.gov.mk, record the XHR calls behind the notices/awarded-contracts grids, and document the resulting service endpoints and pagination as the canonical collection method.

coverage_gaps.description: The machine-readable ESJN concluded-contracts dataset on data.gov.mk has not been located, downloaded or schema-checked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search data.gov.mk for 'склучени договори' / 'јавни набавки', resolve the redirect, download one file and record schema, row count, date range and whether the awarded economic operator and contract value are present.

coverage_gaps.description: No local-language keyword/CPV filter set exists for banking and payments IT subjects.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assemble and test a Macedonian + English term list (софтвер за банкарско работење, картичен систем, ПОС терминали, банкомати/АТМ, платежен систем, МИПС, персонализација на картички, ХСМ, дигитално банкарство, инстант плаќања) against the portal search and record recall per term.

coverage_gaps.description: Beyond NBRSM, the set of relevant contracting authorities for payments/banking IT (Управа за јавни приходи, Царинска управа, Фонд за ПИОМ, ЗФРМ, state-owned enterprises, municipalities operating payment services) has not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate institutions in the ESJN institution list and shortlist those with financial/payment operations; build a watchlist for per-institution monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: Unknown how far back the portal's public archive and any bulk dataset reach, and whether pre-2019 (old ZJN) records are retained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the earliest retrievable notice date on the portal and in the open dataset; if the archive is truncated, evaluate the Ministry of Finance archive site (arhiva.finance.gov.mk) and civic-tech dumps as backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: Award notices name winners; the competitor set (losing bidders) is only partially visible, mainly via appeals decisions and evaluation reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically crawl ДКЖЈН decisions and the evaluation/award-decision PDFs in ESJN dossiers to reconstruct bidder lists per tender.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurements below the mandatory e-publication threshold, and central-bank procurements potentially exempt or confidential, will not appear in the ESJN.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check NBRSM's own procurement page and State Audit Office reports for contracts absent from the ESJN; flag confidentiality exemptions explicitly in the source model.

brief: For North Macedonia, the legally mandated procurement record is concentrated in one system — the ЕСЈН at e-nabavki.gov.mk, operated by the Биро за јавни набавки under the Ministry of Finance — which publishes plans, notices, award decisions and concluded contracts for every contracting authority including НБРСМ. It is rich but hostile to collection: a plain fetch of the public-access page returned 403 (bot defence suspected, not dead), award content sits behind a JavaScript grid and is effectively invisible to web search, and there is no documented public API — only an undocumented dossier endpoint with Id/Level parameters and ASMX services, plus a reported machine-readable republication of the concluded-contracts module on data.gov.mk that still needs verifying. The highest-value surrounding layer is the corroboration ring: ДКЖЈН appeals decisions (which expose losing bidders and annulled awards), Државен завод за ревизија audit reports (which narrate IT and payment-system contracts in detail), contracting authorities' own tender-document mirrors (fuller technical specifications), and the Центар за граѓански комуникации / opendata.mk monitoring output for case studies. Next steps should be technical rather than exploratory: prove a headless read path into the portal, verify the open dataset's schema and freshness, and build the Macedonian banking/payments keyword and CPV filter set that this cell currently lacks.
